title: Configurable business contact info in Contact section

requirements.summary: Replace TBD placeholders in the Contact section with configurable phone/email/address values and render phone/email as clickable links only when configured.
acceptanceCriteria: The Contact section no longer displays the literal text "TBD" for Phone, Email, or Address.
Phone renders as a clickable link using a valid tel: URL when a phone number is present.
Email renders as a clickable link using a valid mailto: URL when an email address is present.
Address renders as plain text (non-link) unless an explicit address link is provided.
If any contact field is not configured, that line item is hidden (rather than showing placeholders).
All user-facing labels remain in English (e.g., "Phone", "Email", "Address").

file_operations.description: Add a frontend-only configuration module exporting business contact information (phone, email, address, and optional explicit addressLink) so it can be updated without touching the Contact section UI logic.

Use the new contactInfo config to build the displayed Contact Information list; remove all "TBD" placeholders; conditionally render each line item only when its configured value is present; generate valid tel: and mailto: hrefs for phone/email; render address as plain text unless an explicit address link is configured. Continue using existing shadcn-ui form components already in this file to preserve styling and behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
